Consumption = NHANES 2017‑18 usual intake (g/day) of the matched generic · groups from the 12‑level FNDDS hierarchy · FRI‑net = meta × agreement, rescaled 1–100 · all 666 matched products (13% Healthier / 20% Neutral / 51% Uncertain / 16% Unhealthier)
Composition and matching from USDA FoodData Central, FNDDS, SR Legacy, FPED, FlavVal and FDA Total Diet Study via FRESH‑Composition. Product photographs and retail product records from GroceryDB (Barabási Lab), used under GNU AGPL v3. Expert scoring follows the published meta‑NPS framework (doi:10.1080/09637486.2023.2241672).
